decision.explanation: The original sources provide distinct associations between Tim Steele and four different sports: football (soccer) in D1S1-D1S4, basketball in D4S2-D4S4, the ARCA series in D5S3-D5S8, and Major League Soccer in D6S3. Each of these associations is independently supported by direct textual evidence and does not conflict with the others because they refer to different individuals named Tim Steele (or Jim Steele in the case of basketball). The audit supports each as a valid referent under the same name. Therefore, all four are retained as valid answers.
